name: Tan Yi Qi
summary: I turn messy, real-world operations problems into models a team can act on. I study Engineering Systems and Design at SUTD with minors in Psychology and Business Management, and my background in applied chemistry keeps me careful about precision and process. I formulate the problem, build the model/dashboard, and test it against real data.

artifacts.title: ROUTING — Recycling Collection Problem
artifacts.description: Modelled 574 real HDB recycling bins as a multi-depot VRP; Simulated Annealing beat Gurobi's exact solution by 2.3x in 14.7s vs 6 hrs.

artifacts.title: DISPATCH — Carbon-Constrained Power Model
artifacts.description: LP across 17,520 half-hourly periods with a custom online gradient descent carbon penalty; emissions landed 0.03% under budget.

artifacts.title: ECOPLUS — Web App & Power BI Dashboard
artifacts.description: Real-time order-entry forms and a colour-coded job tracker replaced scattered manual records for a piping/engineering firm.

whyMe: A capstone succeeds when the problem is framed correctly and the solution holds up on real data. I bring the optimisation and analytics skills to model complex systems, the dashboard and UX sense to make results usable, and the discipline to get the details right.
